transcript: If you are in your 40s, 50s or 60s and you don't feel like yourself anymore, this is probably why. Something quietly changed. Rest doesn't come the way it used to. Your body feels tired, but your mind won't stop. You lie down. But something inside you stays awake and slowly. Without even noticing it, you drifted away from yourself. Not broken, not sick, just not you anymore. And the truth is, you're not the only one feeling this. Most people just learn to live with it, but you don't have to. I created this 30-day journey for people like you, not to push you, not to fix you, but to gently bring you back to yourself, just 10 minutes a day. Simple practices that help your body feel safe again, so your mind can finally let go. This isn't about becoming someone new. It's about coming back to who you were, before all the tension. People don't come here for motivation. They come here because they're tired of feeling this way. And something shifts. They sleep deeper. They wake up lighter. They feel calm again in their own body. If this feels familiar, don't ignore it. The journey is waiting in the link on my profile. 30 days, 10 minutes a day, one time. You've been carrying enough. Let this carry you for a while.
